simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תַּרְדֵּמָה (H8639) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תַּרְדֵּמָה (tardêmâh) means a lethargy or (by implication) trance First listed occurrence: 1Sam 26 12.

definitions.full: H8639. tardemah תַּרְדֵּמָה noun feminine deep sleep ; — absolute ׳ת Gen 2:21 +; construct תַּרְדֵּמַת 1Sam 26:12 ; — deep sleep , usually with נָפַל + עַל person, and usually by supernatural agency: י ׳וַיַמֵּל ׳א ׳ת עַל Gen 2:21 (J; ᵐ5 ἔκστασις ), ׳ת עַל נָָֽפְלָח 15:12 (J; ᵐ5 id. ), Job 4:13 = 33:15 ( ᵐ5 [ δεινὸς ], φόβος ), so י ׳תַּרְדֵּמַת 1Sam 26:12 ( ᵐ5 θάμβος , result of slothfulness ( על and person omitted) Prov 19:15 ; figurative for insensibility of spirit, י עֲלֵיכֶם ׳נָסַךְ ת ׳רוּחַ Isa 29:10 .
